title: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
overview:
A super remake of an eternal classic. A must-see for game enthusiasts!! Can you solve this ultra-difficult mystery?

Zork I: The Great Underground Empire is a text adventure in which your own words drive the story. Starting outside a white house with a small mailbox, you explore forests, cellars and vast caverns beneath the earth, hunting for treasures such as a jeweled egg and a crystal skull while solving puzzles and facing the dangers below.

Instead of typing, you build commands by picking words from prepared lists, and the game responds to what you choose. Image graphics behind the text, a map of the areas you have explored, 3D sound effects for rivers and wind, and original background music for each area add to the atmosphere.

- Commands built from word lists, no keyboard needed
- Background images, area map and item inventory display
- One player, memory backup saves

永遠の名作をスーパーリメイク。ゲームマニア必見！！
君はこの超難解な迷を解くことができるか？
